title: 马斯克如何将政府运作游戏化(5)
desc: 马斯克如何将政府运作游戏化(5)

paragraphs.en: The convergence of code and nativism was stark. Doge's most consequential act of data integration was designed to accelerate mass deportations.
paragraphs.zh: 代码与本土主义的结合十分明显。政府效率部在数据整合方面最具影响力的举措旨在加速大规模驱逐。

paragraphs.en: By March 2025, Musk's operatives had begun building what Wired called a "master database" to track immigrants – knitting together records across the Department of Homeland Security, IRS, Social Security Administration and voting rolls.
paragraphs.zh: 到2025年3月，马斯克的运营团队已开始构建被《连线》杂志称为"主数据库"的系统来追踪移民——该系统整合了国土安全部、国税局、社会保障管理局和选民登记册的记录。

paragraphs.en: It dovetailed with Palantir's $30m "ImmigrationOS" contract with ICE (Immigration and Customs Enforcement), which promised "near real-time visibility" on non-citizens.
paragraphs.zh: 这与帕兰提尔公司与美国移民和海关执法局(ICE)签订的3000万美元"ImmigrationOS"合同相吻合，该合同承诺对非公民提供"近乎实时的监控"。

paragraphs.en: The next month, the New York Times reported that the Trump administration had added thousands of individuals to the social security administration's "death master file", which cut off access to their credit cards and bank accounts.
paragraphs.zh: 次月，《纽约时报》报道称，特朗普政府已将数千人列入社会保障局的"死亡主文件"，导致他们的信用卡和银行账户被冻结。

paragraphs.en: One former commissioner called it "financial murder".
paragraphs.zh: 一位前专员称其为"金融谋杀"。

paragraphs.en: The goal was to choke out people's ability to make a living and force them to "self-deport".
paragraphs.zh: 目的是扼杀人们的谋生能力，迫使他们“自愿遣返”。

paragraphs.en: Trump also called for a national census that would not count undocumented residents, breaking with the principle that had guided American practice since 1790 – the exceptions being enslaved people, counted as three-fifths of a person, and Indigenous people, not counted at all.
paragraphs.zh: 特朗普还呼吁进行一次不统计无证居民的全国人口普查，这违背了自1790年以来指导美国实践的原则——例外情况是，被奴役的人按五分之三个人计算，而原住民则完全不被计算在内。

paragraphs.en: What began as "tech support" for government databases meshed seamlessly with exclusionist politics.
paragraphs.zh: 最初为政府数据库提供的“技术支持”与排外主义政治无缝结合。

paragraphs.en: Before and during his time at Doge, Musk repeatedly referred to what he was doing as "reprogramming the matrix". But what did he mean?
paragraphs.zh: 在任职政府效率部之前和期间，马斯克多次将他所做的事情称为"重新编程母体"。但他指的是什么意思呢？

paragraphs.en: In the film The Matrix, a young hacker named Neo discovers that life is a simulation: humans are stored in bio-mechanical honeycombs as batteries for a digital super-intelligence that pacifies them with an illusion.
paragraphs.zh: 在电影《黑客帝国》中，一位名叫尼奥的年轻黑客发现现实世界其实是一个模拟系统：人类被储存在生物机械构成的蜂巢结构中，作为一台数字超级智能体的电池，以供其向人类施加一种幻觉从而使其保持平静。

paragraphs.en: "Take the red pill," Musk tweeted for the first time in May 2020, invoking the scene where Neo must choose between seeing the truth (red pill) or staying in blissful ignorance (blue pill).
paragraphs.zh: "吃下红色药丸，"马斯克在2020年5月首次发推文时这样写道，他引用了电影中尼奥必须在看清真相（红色药丸）和保持幸福无知（蓝色药丸）之间做出选择的场景。

paragraphs.en: The phrase has become a byword for the 21st-century far right.
paragraphs.zh: 这个短语已成为21世纪极右翼的代名词。

paragraphs.en: Neo's transformation from passive observer to active combatant is catalysed by the red pill.
paragraphs.zh: 红色药丸促使尼奥从被动观察者转变为积极战斗者。

paragraphs.en: Taking the red pill is not just about seeing through the simulation but mastering it.
paragraphs.zh: 吞下红色药丸不仅是为了看透模拟世界，更要掌控它。

paragraphs.en: The decisive shift comes when Neo learns to reprogram the matrix from the inside, enabling him to defeat the black-suited agents who hunt down anomalies.
paragraphs.zh: 当尼奥学会从内部重新编程矩阵时，决定性的转变出现了，这使他能够击败追捕异常者的黑衣特工。

paragraphs.en: By the end of the film, Neo has adopted a chilling interpersonal style.
paragraphs.zh: 到电影结尾时，尼奥已经养成了一种令人不寒而栗的待人方式。

paragraphs.en: If everyone is living in a simulation, then nobody's life matters.
paragraphs.zh: 如果每个人都生活在一个模拟中，那么没有人的生活是重要的。

paragraphs.en: The film's most dramatic sequence features Neo in an overcoat doing cartwheels while mowing down dozens of enemies with guns in both hands and a blank expression on his face.
paragraphs.zh: 这部电影最戏剧性的场景是尼奥穿着大衣，双手持枪面无表情地扫射数十名敌人的同时做着侧手翻。

paragraphs.en: But these are not acts of murder any more than they would be in a video game. The casualties are fake people.
paragraphs.zh: 但这些行为并不比电子游戏中的行为更像是谋杀。伤亡者是虚构的人物。

paragraphs.en: The Matrix is a touchstone for the manosphere, an online community proudly touting male supremacy and misogyny.
paragraphs.zh: 《黑客帝国》是男权主义圈子的试金石，这个网络社区公然宣扬男性至上和厌女思想。

paragraphs.en: Musk has sometimes been described as being part of this group.
paragraphs.zh: 马斯克有时被描述为这个群体的一员。

paragraphs.en: He has indeed been welcomed by manosphere leaders such as Andrew Tate, who had previously been banned from Twitter, later to be restored by Musk.
paragraphs.zh: 他确实受到了男性领域领袖如安德鲁·泰特的欢迎，泰特此前曾被推特封禁，后来被马斯克恢复了账号。

paragraphs.en: In an online conversation with Musk, Tate said the purchase of the social media platform had "cracked the matrix in real time and it becomes extremely difficult now to run the psyops they were previously running and enslave the populace which is their primary goal".
paragraphs.zh: 在与马斯克的一次线上对话中，泰特表示，收购这个社交媒体平台“实时打破了既定格局，现在他们要实施此前的心理战并奴役民众变得极其困难，而奴役民众正是他们的主要目标”。

paragraphs.en: Yet there is a basic but important difference between Musk and the manosphere.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，马斯克和男性至上主义圈子之间存在一个基本但重要的区别。

paragraphs.en: Tate talks about the need to break the matrix or escape from it.
paragraphs.zh: 泰特谈到了打破矩阵或从中逃脱的必要性。

paragraphs.en: Musk is the rare figure who sees the matrix not as the problem, but as part of the solution.
paragraphs.zh: 马斯克是罕见的人物，他不将矩阵视为问题，而是将其视为解决方案的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Muskism, in the end, means building a better matrix.
paragraphs.zh: 马斯克主义，归根结底，意味着构建一个更好的矩阵。

paragraphs.en: This is what Musk was trying to do with Doge, combining ludic qualities of gaming with the fear of infiltration and an attempted renovation of governance through coding.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是马斯克试图通过政府效率部实现的目标，将游戏中的荒诞特质与对渗透的恐惧相结合，并试图通过编码来革新治理方式。

paragraphs.en: In April 2025, he made the analogy literal, posting an image of himself as Neo brandishing two submachine guns in the lobby of the CIA.
paragraphs.zh: 2025年4月，他将这一比喻变成了现实，在中央情报局大厅发布了一张自己扮演尼奥手持两把冲锋枪的照片。

paragraphs.en: But reprogramming the matrix was not as easy as he imagined.
paragraphs.zh: 但是重新编程这个矩阵并不像他想象的那么容易。

paragraphs.en: Musk left Doge at the end of May 2025 after his 130-day tenure as a "special government employee" not in sunglasses but with a black eye (reportedly delivered by his toddler). By then, Doge's website claimed $170bn in savings.
paragraphs.zh: 2025年5月底，马斯克结束了他作为“政府特别雇员”为期130天的任期后离开了政府效率部；他没戴墨镜，而是眼眶淤青（据说是被他刚学步的孩子打的）。到那时，政府效率部的网站宣称节省了1700亿美元。

paragraphs.en: An investigation by the Financial Times could verify "only a sliver of that figure".
paragraphs.zh: 英国《金融时报》的一项调查只能核实"这一数字的一小部分"。

paragraphs.en: After the generous tax cuts for the wealthy in Trump's One Big Beautiful Bill were passed in July 2025, the savings were erased altogether.
paragraphs.zh: 2025年7月特朗普《一个美丽大法案》中针对富人的慷慨减税政策通过后，所有节省资金被彻底抹除。

paragraphs.en: Doge became what Musk described as a "whipping boy" for all manner of public discontent.
paragraphs.zh: 政府效率部成为了马斯克所说的各种公众不满情绪的"替罪羊"。

paragraphs.en: Tesla sales plummeted along with Musk's popularity.
paragraphs.zh: 特斯拉销量暴跌，马斯克的人气也随之下滑。
